clauses.clause: Whenever you attack with three or more creatures, put a +1/+1 counter on target creature you control.

mapping.notes: Tide Skimmer's 'attack with N or more' (at_least(3, quantity=number_you_control(...)) over your attacking creatures in the DeclareAttackersEvent filter, once_per_event); Feat of Resistance's counter on target creature you control. Packs: tools/scenarios/mapped/FDN/armasaur_guide_three_attackers_put_a_counter.json, tools/scenarios/mapped/FDN/armasaur_guide_two_attackers_no_counter.json. Ontology round R12: the tree translated into the one comparison (same meaning), the draft, clauses and notes reworded.
